name: Disaster Response
description: Search and rescue teams, medical personnel, and emergency supplies deployed rapidly to disaster-affected areas.

name: Primary Healthcare
description: Establishment of primary healthcare clinics and medical support to hospitals in under-resourced communities.

name: Water Provision
description: Water purification and borehole projects to provide clean, sustainable water access to communities in need.

name: Feeding Schemes
description: Food parcel distribution and feeding schemes supporting families facing hunger and food insecurity.

name: Education Support
description: Bursaries, school supplies, and educational programmes helping learners stay in school and succeed.

name: Job Creation & Skills Development
description: Entrepreneurship support and skills development programmes to help communities become self-sufficient.
